text:
Nora (PM): Quick design sync 1: compact diff list for prompt-set evals. Goals: make the legend/meaning of badges explicit, offer a colorblind-friendly indicator, and refine the confirmation flow (we want a small undo affordance on success). Mock: https://img.redwood.company/ux/compact-legend.png

Diego (Design): Proposal: add a tiny inline legend at the top of the inspector that maps badge colors -> status (regression, improvement, unchanged). For colorblind mode also add patterns (dots/lines) inside the badge. Want to avoid clutter; legend should be collapsible.

Mei (Frontend): Collapsible legend is fine. For performance, we'll keep legend outside the virtualized list. Colorblind patterns could be CSS background-image SVGs. Also the success flow: after "Set baseline" we can show a non-blocking toast with "Undo" that calls the revert endpoint for 10s. Safer than permanent scary modal copy.

Jonah (UX Research): In tests, participants appreciated explicit legend + patterns. They used the legend to learn badge semantics quickly. The undo toast reduced anxiety vs a heavy warning. Recommend the modal still mention permanence but surface the toast as the first-line recovery. Also users wanted keyboard focus to land in the dialog and return to the row after close.

Diego (Design): Microcopy for success toast:
• "Baseline set. Undo" (button).
Modal copy (short): "Set current outputs as baseline for this prompt set. You can undo immediately via the success toast or view baseline history later."

Mei (Frontend): Small snippets: CSS pattern for colorblind badge: ```css .badge.cb { background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg...>"); } ``` And toast undo handler pseudo: ```js fetch('/api/baseline/revert', {method:'POST', body:{runId}}) ``` We'll gate the toast by feature flag.

a11y-bot: Accessibility notes: legend must be tabbable and announced as "Legend: regression (red, cross hatch), improvement (green, diagonal hatch), unchanged (gray)". Provide high-contrast tokens and ensure patterns convey meaning without color. Modal must have role="dialog", focus trap, and the undo toast should be reachable by keyboard (focusable "Undo" button). Announce toast via aria-live polite.

Nora (PM): Action items:
- Diego: updated mock with collapsible legend + pattern badges + toast copy by Wed.
- Mei: prototype SVG pattern badges + toast undo (feature-flagged) next sprint.
- Jonah: 5 quick follow-up sessions to validate legend discoverability.

Mei (Frontend): I'll also add a11y attributes: legend has aria-label, patterns have aria-hidden=false with title for screen readers, and toast uses role=status. Will post a prototype link when ready.

Nora (PM): Great 1 — sync Thu 9am PT to sign off on copy and toast behavior. If you can't make it, drop a note here.
